scope: 20 corpus cases, the 15 archived sweeps of QA-2026-11-25-02 (5 a side), offline. Reference zone IDs written: A 161 of 320 (0.503), B 145 of 316 (0.459; B-r4 stopped at case 20), C 157 of 320 (0.491). Elements in no zone: A 364, B 378, C 355. Arm B leaves more elements in no zone than both arms A and C, so the falsifier is met and the hypothesis is refuted: the fall has two parts. The larger part is zone ID spelling: of the 16 reference IDs that B writes less than A, 10 are in cases 05, 14 and 17 and 2 in case 12. Arm B writes boundary:outside-network for the reference boundary:public-internet (case 05, 3 of 5), partner-app-servers and similar for boundary:partner-servers (case 14, 5 of 5), and boundary:citys-cloud-account or boundary:city-cloud for boundary:city-cloud-account (case 17, 4 of 5; arm A also writes boundary:citys-cloud-account in 2 of 5). The smaller part is placement: arm B leaves 14 more elements in no zone than arm A, most of them in case 15 (A 21, B 29, C 18); in case 17 arm B leaves fewer (6 against 12). zone_recall matches zones by ID; sourced_zone_recall credits a zone name a reader ruled an alias: A 0.589, B 0.533, C 0.574 (means of 5 sweeps). The new spellings carry no alias ruling. This row reads names and counts only; it does not say whether the extraction prompt causes the new spellings or the extra unplaced elements.
